FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES, SECTOR 14,
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH 160014
Advertisement for Senior Research Fellow (SRF)
Applications are invited along with the complete bio-data and attested copies of certificates showing
qualifications and experience for one post of SRF in the research project entitled “A fluorescent cyclic
peptide conjugated amphipathic-D diastereomers nanotherapeutics for an early detection
and treatment of prostate cancer” by DST-SERB CRG, Government of India (CRG/2022/000628)
granted to Dr. Gurpal Singh (UIPS, PU), Dr Ravi Pratap Barnwal (Department of Biophysics, PU), Prof
Sanjay Kumar Bhadada (PGIMER, Chandigarh) and Prof Rakesh Kapoor (PGIMER, Chandigarh). Intial
appointment is for one year, extended up to 3 years based on the performance. Candidates possessing the
below mentioned Educational Qualification and having a maximum of 33 years of age for SRF as on the
date of the interview (relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidate) may submit their
application to the undersigned along with detailed resume by 20.11.2023 either by post or email at
gurpalsingh.ips@gmail.com
Eligibility: M.Pharm in Pharmaceutics/Pharmaceutical Biotechnology subjects with minimum 55% marks.
“Candidates with GPAT national entrance test conducted by Government of India will be preferred.”
Emoluments: Rs. 35,000/-p.m.+ 16% HRA for three years as per SERB or Panjab University guidelines.
Yours sincerely
Gurpal Singh, Ph.D.
UIPS, Panjab University, Chandigarh
Note: No TA/DA will be provided. The post is purely temporary and commensurate with project.
Candidates should mention their email address and phone number in the bio data.
Copy to:
1. To the incharge computer centre, Panjab University for displaying on the university website
2. The Chairperson, Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences and Drug Research, Punjabi University,
Patiala
3. The Chairperson, Department of Pharmacy, GNDU, Amritsar
4. The Chairperson, UIPS, Kurukshetra University, Kurukshetra

6. The Chairperson, Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences and Natural Products, CUP, Bathinda
7. The Director, NIPER, Mohali
8. The Director, DIPSAR, Delhi
